applicableAreas: All proposed buildings (Bldg 1-8) within clearance distance of overhead electric facilities; south boundary retaining walls adjacent to OHE line
findings.comment: Site plan and section detail sheets do not show dimension lines extending from the outside conductor to the outermost edges of proposed buildings and building projections. Clearance verification is not provided in enlarged plan details or section views.

applicableAreas: South boundary retaining walls adjacent to existing overhead electric line (OHE)
findings.comment: Retaining wall section exhibits do not show dimension annotations from the outer electric conductor to the outermost edge of the wall face. The wall design maximum height of 14 feet and section details do not reference or verify clearance from overhead electric facilities.

applicableAreas: Areas beneath overhead electric line on south boundary where driveways, parking, and structures are proposed
findings.comment: No registered surveyor survey data provided showing overhead electric pole locations, conductor elevations, or mid-span clearance measurements. Vertical clearances from proposed driveways, parking areas, and grades to overhead facilities cannot be verified from submitted plans.

applicableAreas: South boundary landscape area where mitigation trees are proposed directly on or adjacent to overhead electric line (OHE)
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows mitigation trees (identified as 'M' symbols) with canopy circles positioned directly overlapping the marked overhead electric (OHE) line. Proposed tree species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Mexican Redbud, Texas Mountain Laurel) are not verified as utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F or documented as meeting required clearance distances. No clearance dimensions or utility-compatible species notation provided for trees within 10 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors.

applicableAreas: Entire site with adjacent overhead electric facilities on all boundaries
findings.comment: Cover sheet and general notes do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings (Bldg 1-8) within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: No horizontal clearance dimensions shown between building faces and overhead electric conductors. No surveyed conductor locations or elevation data provided to verify that 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance is maintained.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings and facilities on site
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions shown from proposed facilities to overhead electric conductors. Overhead conductor types are not labeled as primary, secondary, or neutral on site plans, and 15-foot radial clearance cannot be verified without surveyed conductor locations.

applicableAreas: Buildings proposed adjacent to Valley View Road right-of-way where overhead electric facilities exist
findings.comment: No clearance dimensions shown from buildings to overhead electric facilities in adjacent right-of-way. Clearance verification cannot be performed without surveyed conductor locations and elevation data.

applicableAreas: Buildings Bldg 1, 2, 3, 7, 8 proposed within potential clearance distance of overhead facilities
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets containing surveyed overhead conductor locations and elevations are provided. Clearance dimensions from finished floor elevations and building projections to overhead conductors cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: South boundary retaining walls adjacent to marked overhead electric line (OHE)
findings.comment: No horizontal clearance dimensions shown from retaining wall face to overhead electric conductors. Without surveyed conductor locations, 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Driveways and parking areas beneath or adjacent to overhead electric line (OHE) on south boundary
findings.comment: No vertical clearance dimensions shown from driveway/parking finished grades to lowest point of overhead electric facilities. Mid-span survey data for overhead conductor sag not provided. Minimum 16-foot (parking without truck traffic) or 18-foot (with truck traffic) vertical clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: South boundary landscape areas, electric easement areas along east boundary
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows mitigation trees positioned at or overlapping the marked overhead electric line. Proposed site features (trees, possibly other landscape elements) may be located within electric easement or beneath/over overhead distribution facilities. Clearance from outside conductor not verified. Surveyed conductor locations and tree planting coordinates needed to confirm whether features maintain required 7.5-foot clearance or violate prohibition on installation under/over distribution facilities.
